title.zh: 知识图谱决策追溯自动系统

description.en: Automatic decision-traceability system: every task run, sub-issue split, delegation, decision and outcome is captured into a typed causal knowledge graph (native task hooks + Semantica decision mirrors + Pythia hypothesis closure + LLM-curated proposals behind a human-confirm gate). Agents consume the graph at claim time and via `multica causal`; the /experimental/causal-graph surface is the workspace-wide overview. On by default.
description.zh: 决策追溯自动系统:每个任务运行、子任务分裂、委托、决策与结果自动汇成类型化因果知识图谱(原生任务钩子 + Semantica 决策镜像 + Pythia 假设闭环 + 人工确认门控的 LLM 提议)。智能体在 claim 时自动收到因果简报,也可用 `multica causal` 主动追溯;/experimental/causal-graph 页面提供全局总览。默认开启。
